build_mlp_vit: build a two-layer MLP block for a Vision Transformer with GELU activation and configurable hidden features
build_mlp_conv: build an MLP using 1x1 convolutions instead of linear layers for NCHW tensor inputs
build_mlp_dropout: build an MLP with configurable dropout rates on both the hidden and output layers
build_mlp_norm: build an MLP with an optional normalization layer applied after the first linear projection
review_mlp_forward: review the Mlp forward pass that chains fc1, activation, dropout, norm, fc2, and dropout
